description: A test class for the TalkDirectiveParser, verifying parsing of voice directives in JSON input, handling of unknown keys, alternate key parsing, and cases with no directive.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParserTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of TalkDirectiveParser parsing functions.

methods.name: parsesDirectiveAndStripsHeader
methods.description: Verifies that the parser correctly extracts voiceId and other properties from JSON input with header and strips the header from the output.

methods.name: ignoresUnknownKeysButReportsThem
methods.description: Checks that the parser correctly handles unknown keys in JSON input and reports them in the result.

methods.name: parsesAlternateKeys
methods.description: Tests parsing of alternative keys like model_id, similarity_boost, no_speaker_boost, and rate.

methods.name: returnsNullWhenNoDirectivePresent
methods.description: Ensures that the parser returns null for the directive when input JSON doesn't contain relevant directive keys.
